issue_request: FHIR-38684 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction for R4B/R5 reporting that build.fhir.org still showed Element.id with structuredefinition-fhir-type valueUrl id after the related FHIR-36036 correction, and requested valueUrl string.
initial_application: No FHIR source commit in this checkout directly references FHIR-38684. The issue followed FHIR-36036, which Jira recorded as a tooling issue with an HL7/kindling pull request, while the active FHIR Element datatype source already declares Element.@id as type string.
additional_context: FHIR-25274 documents the intended System.String plus structuredefinition-fhir-type pattern. FHIR-25262 and the later FHIR-44817 audit keep Resource.id distinct as fhir-type id. Later same-family issue FHIR-41183 reported the same Element.id/ElementDefinition.id id-vs-string defect for R5 and is already audited on the combined branch as no-change because current R6/build output is corrected. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-12-12 list FHIR-38684 as a technical correction that was auto-approved.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source has Element.@id as type string in an active build-scope datatype definition, and the current build.fhir.org Element profile emits Element.id with structuredefinition-fhir-type valueUrl string.
